review: Fresh blind review of source.json, source-contact-sheet.jpg, design.png, and all nine corresponding source/key image pairs only.
source_pose_composition: Composition broadly meets the bar: the near left rider/helper, crossing equipment, fixed central support and distant pair remain recognizable. The foreground rider's pose is the remaining weak point.
same_doodle_identity: Meets the bar. The long outlined plank, angular triangular support and spare hand-drawn line language retain the design's identity within the larger scene.
hinge_action: Meets the sampled-pose bar. The active board changes inclination around the same central support, rises to a high left endpoint and returns; the support and surrounding equipment remain fixed.
rider_helper_contact_occlusion: Broad attachment and overlap order are readable in the samples, but the rider's upright box-like body and minimally articulated legs make the high poses read as standing on the board rather than sitting astride it as in the source.
one_most_important_gap: The foreground rider's seated pose is insufficiently legible, especially in keys 05 through 07.
smallest_repair: Keep the existing head, body style, board path and helper. Redraw only the rider's lower-body lines into a clear seated hip on the plank with two bent knees and short hanging or forward feet, preserving the seat-to-board attachment throughout the lift and return.
playback_evidence: No actual normal-speed playback was performed. This verdict is based on the supplied still samples; timing, interpolation, fluidity and between-sample contact are unverified. comparison.mp4 was not opened or checked through metadata or decoding.
